quest.title: Mountain Mixologist
quest.description: Chef Guanchui, who has just recently returned to Qingce Village, seems to be worried about his friend's thirst-quenching drinks...

dialogues.speaker: Guanchui
dialogues.text: Are you guys from out of town? Welcome to Qingce Village!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon first! Paimon first! Let's introduce ourselves first!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #This is the almighty Traveler, {NICKNAME}, and Paimon is this Traveler's best companion, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We are ordering specialty drinks from the Weinlesefest for out-of-town clients. We saw your commission, so we decided to come talk to you.

response.speaker: Guanchui
response.text: Ah, I like how direct you are! Then I'll cut to the chase, too.

response.speaker: Guanchui
response.text: I'm Chef Guanchui, and I need <color=#00E1FFFF>100 cases of "Fruits of the Festival,"</color> to make tea to help keep the spirits up for the guys doing manual labor.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay! Before we get to work, please give us the funds.

response.speaker: Guanchui
response.text: One step ahead of you. Please take these Fairbrew Jellies! After ordering, there will probably be some left over. Doesn't matter how much is left, please keep the change as reward for your hard work!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll take it and be on our way!

response.speaker: Guanchui
response.text: Right on! I await the good news from both of you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #What are you standing there for, {NICKNAME}? Let's go!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If you have anything to talk about, we'll talk after you place the order.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The sooner we finish the job, the sooner we can open our shop!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Opening a shop, mmhmm...

talks.objective: Return to Springvale and place an order with Georg

dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: Oh! You're back?

dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: Are you still helping to place orders for foreign clients?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup. This time we need 100 cases of "Fruits of the Festival," for Guanchui, the chef of Qingce Village.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're ready to make an offer, Georg!

choices.text: Why do I get the feeling of business rivalry...

response.speaker: Georg
response.text: Oh! The ball's rolling! Let me see what you've got this time!

choices.text: Get ready to be surprised, Georg!

dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: Okay, just like last time, the documents will be given to you, and I will arrange the transportation.

dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: Since he is a new customer, you'd better give him the receipt, so as to make him feel at ease.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You have a point. We thought so too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Let's go, {NICKNAME}. Let's head back to Qingce Village and report back.

talks.objective: Go to Qingce Village and respond to Guanchui's request

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guanchui, we're back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've placed an order for your 100 cases of "Fruits of the Festival." Here's your receipt.

dialogues.speaker: Guanchui
dialogues.text: Amazing! You two have been a big help!

dialogues.speaker: Guanchui
dialogues.text: I will study the "Fruits of the Festival" carefully and mix the fresh drink with the tea with a specific proportion. I'll bring out the flavor, so that the workers will be able to work harder!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh, sounds a bit like bartending, but with tea... Is that even possible?

dialogues.speaker: Guanchui
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I used to be a chef when I was abroad for a while. This approach achieves the best balance between cost and taste, and I've made it many times!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Makes me want to try it...

dialogues.speaker: Guanchui
dialogues.text: The next time you guys come to Qingce Village, I'll treat you guys to the finished product.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Okay! Next time {NICKNAME} can try it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Best of luck, bartending chef!

dialogues.speaker: Guanchui
dialogues.text: Thank you! Come back when you've got time!

dialogues.speaker: Guanchui
dialogues.text: I can't think of a better specialty drink for this Weinlesefest than the tea brewed with the spring water from Qingce Village.

dialogues.speaker: Guanchui
dialogues.text: Thank you, both of you!

choices.text: Could you tell me more about yourself?

response.speaker: Guanchui
response.text: It hasn't been that long since I moved back to the farm with my brothers. Usually I am in charge of cooking for the boys who work in the field.

response.speaker: Guanchui
response.text: But most of what I do is just simple and filling dishes, which are not quite suitable for out-of-town guests.

response.speaker: Guanchui
response.text: Qingce Village is pretty quiet, but there is no shortage of good food. You can tell by just simply walking around!

response.speaker: Guanchui
response.text: The boys working the field are often real thirsty, so thirsty that they end up going through a whole jug of tea in half a day.

response.speaker: Guanchui
response.text: The distance between the tea shop and the fields is quite far. Going to and from is too much trouble.

response.speaker: Guanchui
response.text: Pops Kai is getting a little long in the tooth to bring tea to the boys, so it's now down to me to bring it over.

response.speaker: Guanchui
response.text: A couple of my companions and I went out of town for a while, and the big jug of tea was a little light for us. Sometimes, they wanted something a little stronger.

response.speaker: Guanchui
response.text: So I added something to my tea to bring out a refreshing flavor and let the boys have a little bit of fun.

response.speaker: Guanchui
response.text: Of course, I've only made enough for a couple brothers. Pops Kai still has a business to maintain!

response.speaker: Guanchui
response.text: After taking a break, we would also go to Pops Kai's tea shop and help him with chores.

response.speaker: Guanchui
response.text: Okay! I await the good news!

dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: No, no, that's too little! Even if the total number of the order is higher, the unit price per case shouldn't be this low.

dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: Well, that's not a bad offer, but considering the difficulty of transportation to Qingce Village, it's still a tough one.

dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: Deal! You two are fast learners. The second time we did business, we ended up in a win-win situation for everyone!

dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: Yup, you guys drive a hard bargain!

dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: Ah, I guess I've been underestimated! Let's agree on the price I asked for this time. Think of it as your fee for negotiation skills.
